label: Garage Door Services
audienceNote: Homeowners searching on a phone, often with a broken door in front of them. They want to call quickly, see that the company covers their area, and trust it.
tone: Direct, reliable, calm and practical. Short sentences. No hype.

palettes.name: Steel & Signal
palettes.mood: Dependable navy with a warm orange signal for calls to action. Strong and professional.

palettes.name: Charcoal & Safety Yellow
palettes.mood: Workshop feel: dark charcoal with a bright safety yellow. Bold and high contrast.

palettes.name: Garage Red & Slate
palettes.mood: Confident red for urgency with a cool steel-blue highlight on a slate band. Warm and approachable.

fontPairs.name: Barlow Condensed + Barlow
fontPairs.heading: Barlow Condensed
fontPairs.mood: Sturdy, industrial and very readable on a phone.

fontPairs.name: Oswald + Source Sans 3
fontPairs.heading: Oswald
fontPairs.mood: Tall, confident headlines with a friendly, neutral body.

fontPairs.name: Archivo + Inter
fontPairs.heading: Archivo
fontPairs.mood: Clean and modern; reads as a well-run, current company.

pages.name: Home
sections: Header with the business name, a click-to-call phone button and a Request Service button
Hero: the main service, the service area if known, one primary call button and one secondary quote button
Services overview: repair, new door installation, openers and remotes, only those the business actually offers
How it works: a simple three-step path from call or request to completed job (no promised times)
Questions customers ask (generic, no invented policies)
Final call to action with the phone number and quote request

pages.name: Services
sections: One block per service the business offers (repair, installation, openers and remotes, maintenance), each with a short description and a call button
Emergency versus scheduled work, described without promising response times

pages.name: Contact
sections: Phone, email and address only if provided in the facts; otherwise clearly marked placeholders
Quote request form (preview only: the form must not submit anywhere)
Service area and hours only if provided

trustCueRule: Licensing, insurance, warranties, years in business, ratings and guarantees may be shown ONLY if they appear in the verified facts. Otherwise leave a clearly marked placeholder such as [TO CONFIRM: licence number].
imageGuidance: Use no stock photographs of other companies. Use simple inline SVG or CSS shapes (a stylised garage door, tools) and marked photo placeholders such as [PHOTO: completed installation].
